<b>Pilgrim Bellbearers</b> are ranged Pilgrim [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are common bugs wielding a set of old bells, which they fling at anyone who is not [[Haunting|haunted]].<ref>Pilgrim Bellbearer [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Common bug wielding a set of old bells. The bug will fling the bells at anyone it deems still free."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pilgrim Bellbearers naturally wander, slowly walking and turning around when they reach an edge or a wall.<br>
When Hornet gets within range, they jump backwards and toss a bell at her, which travels in a heavy arc and bounces off a surface once before breaking on the next impact. If there is no space left to jump backwards, they jump forwards instead.

The bell can easily be dodged by simply walking under the initial throw, and maintaining pressure on the Pilgrim Bellbearer prevents them from evading Hornet's strikes. Hornet can also deflect the bells with needle attacks, and can even knock them back at enemies to deal the same amount of damage that a needle hit would.

Their attacks and contact damage both deal {{Damage|1}}

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pilgrim Bellbearers have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Two Pilgrim Bellbearers can be found primarily in the middle of [[Greymoor]], in the cave east of Halfway Home in Act 1-2.<br>
One Pilgrim Bellbearer can be found in the [[Blasted Steps]].<br>
They can also be found alongside a [[Pilgrim Guide]] in a room in Shellwood, provided that the [[Covetous Pilgrim]] previously residing there has been defeated.<br>
During [[Act 3]], Pilgrim Bellbearers can be found in [[Shellwood]] attacking Plinney, and in [[Bonegrave]] outside the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]] depending on the RNG layout.
